original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: All endpoints E_q between the original entrance S_q and FULL for each of 78 originally restricted selected k8 helpers, jointly with all A/B/early-cleanup frames. Original end subspace is no longer a cap. Fixed scalar operations/order, centre/target cut, entrances and early/full cleanup membership; all 402 full-cleanup helper ends stay FULL.
scope_change_reason: Removes the old-terminal-subspace cap from PR1995, allowing every terminal subspace containing each fixed entrance, jointly with all gate frames. A negative screen does not satisfy the construction acceptance gate.
bottleneck_link: Decides whether arbitrary helper terminal geometry can lower the complete per-call excess cost enough for the 5% target, beyond the proved nested-contraction class.
stop_rule: One complete unrestricted-terminal endpoint screen or a precisely documented interface obstruction. No scalar reorder, entrance change or cleanup change.
evidence: All 396241 LP columns in 129 components pass exact rational dual checks at the ceiling endpoint and the 5% target. A separate bitset/covector/integer-root checker agrees. The same four-end profile as PR1995 attains the bound; the unrestricted terminal domain retains a < 0.001690198050303, less than 0.00852% above the fixed-end ceiling. The attaining word passes the 704-column scalar/frame audit in both orientations.
author: Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, checking and writing; no independent human review.

open_questions.question: Can changed entrances or one scalar dependency yield enough complete-profile gain?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Those changes alter the forced frame spans and escape this fixed-word, fixed-entrance domain.
open_questions.first_step: Pin one exact new entrance or dependency and reconstruct all gates, cones and the complete local/idle bill.
open_questions.blocked_by: Arbitrary-dirty scalar correctness, frame legality and a target-scale exact cost screen.

open_questions.question: Can a candidate attaining the unrestricted-terminal relaxation be physically hosted?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A local LP witness does not establish a global supplier improvement.
open_questions.first_step: Materialize its exact annotations, run native emission/phase/wrapper checks and price one complete owner placement.
open_questions.blocked_by: Emitted-interface admission, whole-call hosting and the inherited precision/outer obligations.
